sample_unit: progress notes (annotated subset; 4,762 notes from 293 patients extracted overall)

links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy vs dual-annotator ground truth for CRS/ICANS and other adverse events
links.effect: CRS and ICANS grading accuracy 0.97 and 0.91; prespecified AE accuracies 0.62–0.76; non-prespecified AE accuracies 0.76–0.84; kappa 0.86–0.96 for CRS/ICANS.
links.quote: Performance was high on CRS and ICANS grading (accuracy of 0.97 and 0.91, respectively).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of GPT-4 zero-shot prompt extraction of adverse events, severity grades, and timelines from clinical notes of CAR-T patients compared to manual annotators, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
